import sys

def solve():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    s = data[0]
    c = list(s)
    l = 0
    r = 0
    ans = 0
    while l < len(c):
        while r < len(c) and c[r] == c[l]:
            r += 1
        if ((r - l) & 1) == 0:
            ans += 1
        l = r
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve()
